generation.exact_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: 16:9 editorial feature hero for a HobFarm Workshop Notes article. Input image 1 is a style reference only: carry forward its tactile torn-paper collage, deep Atlantic blue-black ground, salt-white newsprint, oxidized red accents, restrained turquoise, scratched film texture, and sophisticated handmade magazine finish. Do not copy its left-to-right timeline, shark pose, objects, or composition.

Primary request: create a wide editorial illustration of a simple suggestion becoming a wandering article route. A single calm shark silhouette is integrated into an irregular hand-drawn route that begins at one loose paper scrap, swims through a field of clipped notes, film-frame fragments, source cards, archival newsprint, image crops, a small camera, and public article-page shapes, branches into several tempting side paths, then curves visibly back toward its starting point. The route should feel improvisational and exploratory, with loops, pauses, forks, taped joins, pencil corrections, and one clearly readable return—not like a corporate flowchart or literal software architecture diagram. A few side branches may terminate in a tornado-like spiral of torn paper, an old documentary frame, a tracking-map pulse, and a surreal desert-horizon fragment, but keep all of them generic and original.

Composition/framing: full-bleed landscape 16:9, strong readable shark-and-route silhouette at thumbnail size, layered depth, generous quiet space near the upper center for live HTML headline overlay, no border. The central visual movement should wander outward and return.

Lighting/mood: nocturnal editorial worktable crossed with an underwater field, cinematic but tactile, strange, intelligent, slightly funny, not mystical or corporate.

Constraints: no words, no legible writing, no letters, no logos, no brands, no private interfaces, no file paths, no prompt text, no glowing AI brain, no generic neural-network nodes, no direct Grateful Dead iconography, no Jaws poster imitation, no swimmer, no attack, no blood, no open shark mouth, no copyrighted movie characters or poster compositions, no watermark. Keep headline out of the image; it will be rendered as editable HTML.
